items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: In fact, there was one trumpet player before him, even, Tommy Stevenson, that was with the original Jimmy Lunceford Lunceford band.

ctx.x: Then, of course, I can go down to -- in the thirties I played with Al Killian Kahan in Don's band. Al Kahan was playing high notes before Maynard Ferguson or any of those guys. In fact, there was one trumpet player before him, even, Tommy Stevenson, that was with the original Jimmy Lunceford Lunceford band.
